titulo.alumno: A change to the recipe · Recipes and allergens

intro: Part 3: a change to the recipe. Compare the two clues and distinguish what the text says from what it only seems to suggest.

texto: Recipes usually express instructions with the imperative and quantities with units. On a label, look for «indeholder» (contains) and «kan indeholde» (may contain): they do not express the same degree of certainty.
Compare the two clues and distinguish what the text says from what it only seems to suggest.
